rationale: ResponsiveTable is the only packaged design-system export that matches the semantic need: genuinely tabular row-column comparative data (Criterion / Evidence / Status). Its registry entry (responsive-table) has catalog_status 'packaged-react-v0.1.0', allowed_action 'REUSE_WITH_VERIFICATION', and an independent-consumer smoke test recorded 2026-11-22. The component supplies: a labelled scrollable region (role=region, tabIndex=0, aria-label), column th[scope=col] headers, optional first-column th[scope=row] row headers (used here with firstColumnIsRowHeader=true), and horizontal overflow containment. No other packaged export (KeyDecisionsAccordion, ProofStrip, CaseStudyImageLightbox) fits the structured-comparison use case. Entries with catalog_status 'source-snapshot-in-catalog' or 'reference-demo-not-packaged' are not portable package APIs per AGENTS.md and were not used.
commands_run: npm run build (consumer/) — tsc --noEmit && vite build
build_result: PASS — TypeScript type-check (tsc --noEmit) succeeded with zero errors; Vite production build succeeded in 578ms. Three 'use client' directive warnings were emitted by Rollup for the design-system bundle; these are benign in a non-RSC Vite context and caused no build failure.
testing_limitations: No browser render verification was performed; build success does not confirm visual or interactive correctness.
No keyboard navigation test was run (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space); the contract requires verifying focus on the scrollable region.
No viewport testing was run at 1440px, 768px, or 390px; horizontal overflow behaviour at narrow widths is unverified.
No screen-reader or WCAG audit was run; the component's aria-label, th[scope] markup, and tabIndex are present in source but not independently verified.
Row status values are explicitly labelled as sample content ('Example — not evaluated') and do not assert any real audit outcome.
The document <title> was added to index.html; visible heading and accessible table label are present in source but not confirmed in a rendered browser session.
The 'use client' directive warnings were reviewed and deemed benign, but were not independently validated against a Next.js or RSC environment.
human_review_needed: Interactive browser test at 390px, 768px, and 1440px to confirm no document-level horizontal overflow.
Keyboard accessibility verification: table region receives focus via Tab; scrollable region is navigable.
Screen reader spot-check: column and row headers are announced correctly; aria-label is read on region entry.
Confirm sample row status text ('Example — not evaluated') is appropriate for the intended enterprise case study context before publication.
Review 'use client' Rollup warnings if the consumer is later integrated into an RSC or Next.js environment.
